treaty_name: Convention between the Kingdom of the Netherlands and Ireland for the elimination of double taxation with respect to taxes on income and capital gains and the prevention of tax evasion and avoidance (2019)
eif_quote: De bepalingen van het Verdrag, met Protocol, zullen ingevolge artikel 30, eerste lid, van het Verdrag op 29 februari 2020 in werking treden, met inachtneming van het gestelde in artikel 30, eerste tot en met vierde lid, van het Verdrag.
source_title: wetten.overheid.nl consolidated text BWBV0006817 (English authentic text)

rates.quote: Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 2, the Contracting State of which the company is a resident shall exempt from tax dividends paid by that company, if the beneficial owner of the dividends is: a) a company (other than a partnership) which is a resident of the other Contracting State and holds directly at least 10 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends throughout a 365 day period that includes the day of the payment of the dividends

However, such dividends may also be taxed in the Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the dividends is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 15 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends.
Interest arising in a Contracting State and beneficially owned by a resident of the other Contracting State shall be taxable only in that other State.
Royalties arising in a Contracting State and beneficially owned by a resident of the other Contracting State shall be taxable only in that other State.

ppt.quote: Notwithstanding the other provisions of this Convention, a benefit under this Convention shall not be granted in respect of an item of income if it is reasonable to conclude, having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit, unless it is established that granting that benefit in these circumstances would be in accordance with the object and purpose of the relevant provisions of this Convention.

notes: Replaces the 1969 Convention (Art. 30(2)); Art. 30(3) allowed election of the 1969 Convention for 12 months after effect. Effect (Art. 30(1)): taxable years/periods and events on or after 1 January of the year following entry into force (EIF 2020-02-29 -> 2021-01-01; Ireland: years of assessment / financial years from that date). Dividend exemption (Art. 10(3)) is a 0% tier: modelled as exclusive (max_rate null); also applies to pension funds (Art. 10(3)(b)) - not modelled. Protocol X: Art. 10(3) does not apply to a Dutch fiscal investment institution (FBI). Not an MLI covered tax agreement; PPT is in the treaty itself (Art. 22(1)), with discretionary relief in Art. 22(2).
